evidence.title: NotchFlow — Pomodoro Timer and Focus Music for Mac

name: NotchFlow
summary: macOS focus app that turns the Mac notch into a Pomodoro timer with music controls and curated focus music.
description: A macOS productivity app that renders a Dynamic Island-style interface around the Mac notch: 25-minute Pomodoro focus intervals, coffee-break reminders, controls for Apple Music and Spotify, and curated focus music. Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon; Intel Macs are not supported.
contains: Pomodoro timer with 25-minute focus intervals and breaks
music controls for Apple Music and Spotify
curated focus music and coffee-break reminders
Dynamic Island-style interface built around the Mac notch
macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon only, under 50 MB RAM
